name: Beat the clock
description: A 30-second mental arithmetic sprint. Problems are generated each review; the card submits itself when time runs out. Score = correct ÷ target.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Optional line shown under the prompt (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: mode
fields.description: "sums" (two-digit addition and subtraction), "times" (times tables to 12), "percent" (simple percentages) or "mixed".

fields.name: seconds
fields.description: Length of the round, 10 to 120 seconds.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Correct answers needed for full credit.
